game_concept: A programming puzzle set in The Kingdom – Festival Grounds, the festival grounds: the herald must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Score Keeper: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while siege rats close in.
theme: The Kingdom – Festival Grounds: the festival grounds
core_gameplay_loop: In Festival Grounds, repeat each round: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while siege rats close in. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the score value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the throne using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the throne is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 2 (intro tier): Score Keeper
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Score Keeper' (Week 1 slot 6), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Festival Grounds'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against siege rats in Festival Grounds.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The throne reached with actions_used <= 19.
